B MODELLING ELEVATORS (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
This task is about the mass an elevator carries and the time it takes to move between floors.
EasyUp is a company that makes elevators.
For each type of elevator, the company uses two mathematical models.
Model 1
The company models the masses of the passengers using the elevator.
Model 2
The company models the time it takes the elevator to move between floors.
1 The EasyUp-5 elevator carries a maximum of 5 passengers.

• 0 and 1 give a mass of 50 kg
